items.label: Yuanjie annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-25-2026)
items.signal_prefix: 2026 business plan (company): expand capacity through the Phase II R&D

set.signal: 2026 business plan (company): expand capacity through the planned Phase II R&D and production base for optoelectronic communication semiconductor chips and devices, buying core equipment to raise high-end laser-chip capacity, and push ahead with overseas plant construction in an orderly way; focus R&D and commercialisation on higher-power CW light sources and high-speed EML lasers for 800G / 1.6T modules and NPO / CPO packaging, and widen global customer coverage to match high-speed optical-interconnect demand.

items.reason: The annual report never states a Phase II investment amount or a March 2, 2026 shareholder approval; '12.51' in the report is the national broadband-port count (12.51 hundred million ports). The March 2, 2026 meeting (half-year report) approved raising the 50G project's investment, not Phase II. Unsourced clause and figure removed.
items.evidence: 以拟投建的光电通讯半导体芯片和器件研发生产基地二期项目为契机 ... 通过光电通讯半导体芯片和器件研发生产基地二期项目的实施，加大对核心设备进行采购，稳步扩大产能

items.label: Yuanjie half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-29-2026)
items.signal_prefix: H1 2026 by market: data-center revenue RMB 77,421.66 ten-thousand

set.signal: H1 2026 by market: data-center revenue RMB 77,421.66 ten-thousand, up 640.29% YoY; telecom revenue RMB 14,843.70 ten-thousand, up 48.63% (the company stepped up customer promotion of 10G EML; its 25G/50G PON laser chips were delivered in volume and formed scale revenue). Data-center products are CW and EML chips: CW 70mW / 100mW laser chips for silicon-photonics modules continued large-volume delivery and are the data-center business's main product; the 100G EML has begun volume shipments and the company says it will ramp gradually; customer validation of the 200G PAM4 EML is progressing steadily. The company says it is entering a wider range of customer supply chains and further integrating into international market supply chains.

items.reason: The report says only 25G/50G PON chips were delivered in volume; for 10G EML it says the company stepped up customer promotion, not volume delivery.
items.evidence: 在原有2.5G、10GDFB 半导体激光器芯片的基础上，加大10GEML 产品的客户推广。面向下一代25/50GPON 网络的半导体激光器芯片产品实现批量交付并形成了规模收入
